#### Further reading:
1. Navigating the Research Data Landscape: Publication Practices at a Swedish University. Maria Almbro & Lisa Olsson. The Research Data Management Team, Stockholm University. Recorded lecture [available on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VJ5AzujeN_I)

2. Forskning och innovation för framtid, nyfikenhet och nytta. Prop. 2024/25:60. Accessed from [https://www.regeringen.se/rattsliga-dokument/proposition/2024/12/prop.-20242560](https://www.regeringen.se/rattsliga-dokument/proposition/2024/12/prop.-20242560)

3. Open Peer Review case study: Rosie Berners-Lee, Eamonn Gilmore, Francisco Berkemeier, Michael A. Boemo. Regulation of replication timing in Saccharomyces cerevisiae. bioRxiv 2024.10.11.617780; doi: [https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.10.11.617780](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.10.11.617780)

4. Open Peer Review case study: Roager L, Kempen PJ, Bentzon-Tilia M, Sonnenschein EC, Gram L. 2024. Impact of host species on assembly, composition, and functional profiles of phycosphere microbiomes. mSystems9:e00583-24. [https://doi.org/10.1128/msystems.00583-24](https://doi.org/10.1128/msystems.00583-24)
